chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The origin of the ruination of the body is the neglect of the dinner.
ai.seo_question: What is the main cause of bodily weakness according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the neglect of the evening meal (al-'asha') as the root cause of bodily decay, reflecting the early Shia emphasis on practical hygiene and physiological balance. This teaching aligns with the broader Islamic medical tradition, which views regular, moderate nourishment as essential for sustaining the body as an amanah (trust) from God.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The origin of the ruination of the body is the neglect of the dinner’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ’
The origin of the ruination of body is in ignoring dinner.’”
